purpose: Add five prespecified full unsteered JEPA-WM Reach-Wall episodes for later exact paired intervention comparisons; no outcome screening or replacement.
pairing_contract: Each saved baseline is the unsteered member of a later block sharing its exact initial simulator state, goal, and planner seed with real steering and matched-sham arms.
analysis_rule: All five episodes are retained regardless of success, failure, or duplicate task realization. Episodes, not replans or frames, are the sampling units.
